turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's use the time. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went up where he could see it on his phone in class?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
You asked for it. I asked you a question.
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
My record isn't on the table. Owen's is, and you've now dodged twice, so what do you have?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
Following the evidence. Then put it on the desk, because so far all I've had is compliments.
